name: Real-World MDN Web Docs (Mobile 390×844) Search Contrast Failure

groundTruth.defect: Mobile search input field has white text (#ffffff) on light gray background (#f1f5f9) causing severe WCAG AA contrast failure, with collapsed 2px padding and red border.
groundTruth.rootCause: White text on light gray background yields contrast ratio < 1.3:1 (fails WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum)
groundTruth.suggestedFix: Restore text color to #1b1b1b, restore default input padding, and remove #ef4444 border
